summary: Find authentication, authorization, ownership, and fail-open bypass paths.
questions: Can another entry, fallback, or absence path reach the effect without the same authorization check?
Is any policy enforced only in UI, documentation, or one controller path?
reject_when: authorization exists only in a client or presentation layer
a missing annotation, principal, or configuration silently allows the effect
escalate_when: material evidence identifies a failure outside this Lens concern
an affected artifact or boundary has no selected Lens owner
